info.title: MatchIQ API
info.summary: Synthetic football intelligence: fixtures, replay, insights and overlays.
info.description:
Generated from the Zod contracts in `libs/contracts` (ADR-0017). All data is synthetic.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with `type = urn:matchiq:problem:<slug>`.

Conventions, versioning, pagination, idempotency, auth and streaming: `docs/api/README.md`.

get.summary: Subscribe to the fixture stream (SSE)
get.description:

get.summary: Detected insights with their evidence
get.description:
Detection order, `(detectedSequence, insightId)`. Keyset pagination: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. A tampered cursor, or one from another list, is `400 invalid-cursor`. A cursor is bound to its match. `limit` defaults to and is capped at 500, so a call without a cursor returns the whole list for matches up to that size.

Access: requires the `insights:read` permission. The anonymous demo principal holds it when `AUTH_ANONYMOUS_DEMO_ENABLED=true`.
